strings.name: Jay Chou
strings.summary: Raised in Taiwan, Chou trained in piano and cello at school and debuted with his self-titled album in 2000. He combines R&B, hip-hop, classical and Chinese-language musical elements, working over many years with Vincent Fang and other creators. Alongside albums and tours, he acts, directs films and co-founded JVR Music. His songwriting, production and cross-media practice have influenced generations of Mandopop listeners.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Combining musical languages
strings.highlights.h1.text: Brings R&B, hip-hop and traditional musical elements into Chinese-language work in collaboration with lyricists.

strings.highlights.h2.text: Albums, tours, acting and directing carry his musical style into different media.

strings.timeline.t1.text: Released his sixteenth studio album, continuing his composition, production and music-video work.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Album tops global sales chart
strings.timeline.t2.text: IFPI announced Greatest Works of Art led the 2022 global album chart for physical and download sales.

strings.timeline.t4.title: Directs Secret

strings.timeline.t5.title: Appears in Initial D
strings.timeline.t5.text: Played Takumi Fujiwara in the adaptation, beginning an important phase of film acting.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Releases Fantasy
strings.timeline.t6.text: His second album developed his blended style and broadened his influence in Mandopop.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Releases debut album
strings.timeline.t7.text: Released the self-titled Jay, entering the record market as a singer and creator.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Taiwan
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born in Linkou, learned piano as a child and continued formal training in a school music program.
